metric_note: metrics.json records the maximum CONTA174 normal pressure and the minimum solved Y displacement extracted from the native RST.
note: Rebuilt and solved in ANSYS 2026 R1 with a true radius-10 mm sphere, 100 x 10 x 100 mm plate, locally refined SOLID187 mesh, TARGE170/CONTA174 frictionless contact, fixed plate bottom, laterally restrained sphere top, total FY=-500 N, NLGEOM, and automatic substeps. The revised local evaluator checks those model facts while leaving the CPRESS numeric acceptance window deferred to a native 2026 R1 review. The isolated Abaqus candidate failed the native evaluator and was removed.
